Event List - Sequential Fixed error when number of events created in a scan is greater than Out_EventList array size ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The List Sequential instruction is designed to monitor an event queue and generate a list of events. As events appear in the queue, the List Sequential instruction monitors event data and determines if each event should be added to the list based on the enumerated configuration of Cfg_Type. New events are added to the output array will be added at array location [0], with the oldest event located at array location ‘n’.
--Events that match the Cfg_Type value are added to the output array, events not matching will be ignored. --Output array size is independent of the source queue.
Output Array Data Management: The ‘List Sequential’ instruction is designed to add each event matching the configured type to the output array. --The instruction places data in the output array sequentially as events are processed, with the most recent event placed at array location [0] and oldest event at array location ‘n’. --A count of one is automatically attached to each Event.
Instruction Execution: ----- Level
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1010 Ref_QueueData array length is greater than Ref_WorkingData array length. 1011 Invalid queue pointer (outside array)
Revision Notes: ----- 2.1.00 - Fixed error when number of events created in a scan is greater than Out_EventList array size 2.0.00 - Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. 1.0.00 - Release
